CFML Language Reference: Functions

DayOfWeekAsString

Converts a weekday number from 1 to 7 into its English name.

Category

Date and time functions

Syntax

DayOfWeekAsString(day_of_week)

Parameters

day_of_week
A number from 1 (Sunday) to 7 (Saturday).

Returns

The full English name of the day, for example "Friday".

Usage

A number outside 1 to 7 throws a parameter validation error. For a localized or abbreviated name of an actual date, use DateFormat with the ddd or dddd mask instead.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<UL>
<CFLOOP INDEX="I" FROM="1" TO="7">
  <CFOUTPUT><LI>#I# = #DayOfWeekAsString(I)#</CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</UL>

See also

DayOfWeek, MonthAsString, DateFormat
